reason: Provides DeepSeek Harness with web_search through SearXNG and web_fetch through Crawl4AI, using configurable external services and optional authentication.

summaries.zh: 通过可配置的 SearXNG 和 Crawl4AI 服务，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索与网页抓取能力。
summaries.en: Adds web search through SearXNG and web fetching through Crawl4AI to DeepSeek Harness using configurable external services.

capabilities: Sends form-encoded search requests to a configured SearXNG service
Fetches HTTP(S) URLs through a configured Crawl4AI service
Reads optional API credentials from plugin configuration or environment variables
